```artifact
Feature: User Experience and Documentation for Virtual Consultation System

  Scenario: Non-technical users can complete a Consultation Request within 5 minutes
    Given a user with no computer background
    When the user initiates a Consultation Request
    And the system presents only minimal and relevant questions
    Then the user should be able to complete the request in less than 5 minutes

  Scenario: System navigation is simple and intuitive
    Given a user accessing the system's main dashboard
    When the user attempts to perform a common task (e.g., scheduling a consultation)
    Then the navigation path should consist of no more than three clicks

  Scenario Outline: Installation Guide preparation
    Given the development environment is set up
    When the installation guide is generated
    Then the guide should include step-by-step instructions for system setup

    Examples:
    | step | description                                    |
    | 1    | Download the latest system package             |
    | 2    | Extract the package to the designated directory |
    | 3    | Run the installation script                    |

  Scenario Outline: User Manual preparation for end users
    Given the user documentation template is available
    When the user manual is generated
    Then the manual should contain clear instructions for end users

    Examples:
    | section          | content                                                                 |
    | Getting Started  | Overview of the system and initial setup steps                                   |
    | Scheduling       | Instructions for scheduling a virtual consultation                               |
    | Troubleshooting  | Common issues and their resolutions                                             |
```
